plugin.name: OfflineTides
plugin.summary: Offline tidal-height forecasts from authenticated .xtdt packages.
plugin.author: Paul (pob220)
plugin.description: OfflineTides predicts offline water-level height at the chart cursor, an OpenCPN waypoint or mark, or manual WGS84 coordinates. It displays datum-labelled rolling or selected-date curves, interpolated high and low water events, local data quality and daylight-saving-aware display times while retaining UTC internally.
